name: NAG, ComfyUI-NAG fork family (φ form, parallel model classes)
plain: The fork family keeps a separate NAG negative conditioning and swaps model classes (Flux, Chroma, HiDream, SD3, Hunyuan, Wan, SD) for NAG copies that run it inside attention. A CFG guider wraps this so the outer CFG can stay 1.
math:
z̃ = z₊·φ − z₋·(φ−1)
r = ‖z̃‖₁/‖z₊‖₁ over last dim
ẑ = z̃·min(r,τ)/r
z = α·ẑ + (1−α)·z₊
z₋ = attention with the NAG negative context. Active while sigma > nag_sigma_end (and ≤ nag_sigma_start in Extended).

props.extra_model_calls: 0 extra UNet calls; one extra attention per patched block
